title: Validate normalized shipment items
prompt: Shipment accepts item keys as strings or symbols and normalizes them to strings. Reject input when two distinct keys normalize to the same SKU instead of silently overwriting one quantity. Also reject every quantity that is not a positive integer. Preserve the existing empty-shipment error, keep the normalized items frozen, and add focused tests.

workflows: publish frozen normalized items only after validation
concepts: string and symbol keys can normalize to one SKU
invariants: one normalized SKU has exactly one unambiguous positive quantity
rubric.impact_question: If Shipment later accepts aliases that map several external SKUs to one canonical SKU, where should collision policy live and which current invariant would need to change?
accepted_alternatives: compare normalized-key cardinality before building the final hash
build the normalized hash while rejecting a key already seen

runtime_only_if_observed: a normalization approach that silently overwrote a quantity
a validation strategy rejected after observable evidence
